analysis.title: GS Blekos - Marketcolour + Flow / Luxury / Vallourec / ITM / Cross Asset 24 Nov 2026
key_insights: US equities rebounded sharply after choppy weeks. SPX +473bps to 7237 (best session since 9 April 2024), NDX +686bps to 26746, RTY +340bps to 2669, with 9 of 11 sectors up.
The AI trade led the rebound on Nvidia headlines. GS AI Semis basket (GSCBSMHX) +14% and GS Data Center basket (GSTMTDAT) +12%. European semis also rallied, with GSSBSEMI +8.2%.
Momentum composition shifted. 12m Momentum (GSPRHIMO) outperformed 3m and 6m momentum by the largest spread on record. PB book medium-term momentum exposure is at the 20th percentile over 5 years.
Volumes were very heavy. ETFs were ~37% of the tape, the highest since April versus a 5yr average of 25%. Levered ETFs were ~$1 of every $4 of ETF volume, a record share.
US ETF short flows rose 8.5% on Friday and 19% last week, the 3rd largest weekly increase in a decade.
US pensions are modeled to buy $27bn of US equities, in the 83rd percentile over three years and 93rd percentile since Jan 2000.
Buyback desk activity stayed elevated, at 2.2x 2025 YTD ADTV and 2.4x 2024 YTD ADTV. Mix shifted to 47% open market versus 53% 10b5-1, from 45%/55% the prior week.

Hedge funds cut TMT and added to cyclicals and defensives, with biggest net tilt increases in Financials, Consumer Discretionary and Industrials. HF exposure to Momentum fell to the lowest since the start of the AI trade in early 2023.
Nvidia Buy retained with PT $220 (35% upside), following Huang's reinstatement as CEO. GS expects a multiple re-rate but residual pressure while investigations are pending.

Cross-asset: GS is modestly pro-risk for 2027 and favours balance. 12m equity return potential looks more attractive after last week's risk-off, and more negative equity-bond correlations should add diversification benefit.

Luxury tracker: early Q4 data broadly in line with 3Q26. US is strong, possibly with a wait-and-see attitude before midterms, while China remains weak. Buy LVMH, Prada, Moncler, Richemont versus Hermes, Swatch.
Vallourec Buy, PT raised to EUR26.90 from EUR26.60 (c.80% upside). GS sees the post-results sell-off as an entry point and expects the valuation gap to Tenaris to narrow.
ITM Power upgraded to Neutral. Shares are down 61% in six months, and the upgrade is driven by price performance rather than fundamentals.

market_movers.rationale: Positive risk/reward on fundamentals and Huang's reinstatement as CEO. Multiple expected to re-rate, though investigations still weigh.
Vallourec 2026/27/28 EBITDA revised -7%/+1%/+1%. Post-results sell-off seen as attractive, with gap to Tenaris expected to narrow.
ITM Power upgrade to Neutral driven by a 61% six-month share price fall, making risk/reward more balanced.

Corporate buyback windows are open post earnings, with opportunistic orders particularly on Friday.
